description: A four-panel composite TEM figure, (a)-(d), tracking j-phase precipitation during aging of a 28.8Mn-9.4Al-0.92C (wt.%) steel at 500°C. Each panel pairs an inset selected-area electron diffraction pattern, all labelled [100]γ, with a centred dark-field TEM image acquired using {100} superlattice reflections (the caption states the pattern is the austenite [001] zone axis, which disagrees with the printed [100]γ label). (a) initial stage and 2 min aging: the pattern shows only weak, diffuse superlattice spots and the dark-field image (100 nm scale bar) is a broad, featureless diffuse band, so individual particles cannot be resolved. (b) 16 min aging: superlattice spots are sharper and more intense; the dark-field image (50 nm scale bar) resolves a dense speckle of fine bright particles. (c) 4 h aging: dark-field image (100 nm scale bar) shows clearly visible, round particles. (d) 64 h aging: dark-field image (100 nm scale bar) shows cuboidal particles aligned in rows along <100> directions, annotated "g = 100" with a white arrow. The sequence demonstrates progressive, order-increasing j-phase precipitation and coarsening from diffuse clusters to cuboidal particles.

subfigures.description: SAED pattern labelled [100]γ with only weak, diffuse superlattice spots, above a dark-field TEM image (100 nm scale bar) that is a single broad diffuse bright band with no resolvable discrete particles (initial stage / 2 min aging).
SAED pattern labelled [100]γ with sharper, more intense superlattice reflections, above a dark-field TEM image (50 nm scale bar) showing a dense speckle of very fine bright particles (16 min aging).
SAED pattern labelled [100]γ, above a dark-field TEM image (100 nm scale bar) showing many fine, round, bright particles distributed densely through the matrix (4 h aging).

SAED pattern labelled [100]γ, above a dark-field TEM image (100 nm scale bar) showing coarser cuboidal bright particles arranged in rows along <100>, annotated 'g = 100' with a white arrow (64 h aging); particles plotted against a dark stepped contrast background.

observations.observation: The figure is a four-panel composite (a)-(d); every panel contains a selected-area diffraction inset plus a dark-field TEM image, so the group is uniform in modality.
All four diffraction insets are labelled [100]γ, whereas the caption states the patterns are austenite in the [001] zone axis; the printed label and the caption disagree.
Panel (a) dark-field image has a 100 nm scale bar and shows only a broad, featureless diffuse bright band with no individually resolved particles.
Panel (b) dark-field image carries a 50 nm scale bar (the only 50 nm bar in the figure) and resolves a dense speckle of fine bright particles.

Panels (c) and (d) dark-field images both carry 100 nm scale bars and show increasingly dense/discrete bright precipitates, with (d) showing aligned cuboidal particles and the annotation 'g = 100' beside a white arrow.
The caption states the dark-field images were taken using {100} superlattice reflections and that the micrograph series follows aging at 500°C.
The citing text reports the steel was solution treated at 1000°C for 10 min and water quenched before aging.

The citing text states that even in the initial state diffuse superlattice reflections from intragranular j-phase are distinguishable in the austenite diffraction pattern (Fig. 8a), and that after 2 min aging they remain weak and diffuse and j-phase cannot be imaged by dark field.
The citing text states that after 16 min aging the j-phase reflections are less diffuse and more intense, indicating an increased volume fraction (Fig. 8b).
The citing text states that after 4 h aging the j-phases are clearly visible in dark-field imaging, round in shape, and smaller than 5 nm (Fig. 8c).
The citing text states that after 64 h aging the j-phases are cuboidal, sized between 5 nm and 10 nm, and arranged along the <100> directions of austenite (Fig. 8d).
No numeric size or composition values are printed inside the images themselves; the nm-scale particle sizes come only from the citing text.

sample_hints: solution treated at 1000°C for 10 min, water quenched
unreadable_items: Individual superlattice reflection indices are not printed on any diffraction pattern inset.
The zone-axis assignment is contradictory: insets are labelled [100]γ but the caption states [001]; neither can be independently confirmed from the pixels.
Panel (a) dark-field image contains no resolvable particles, so the '2 min aging' microstructure cannot be distinguished from the initial stage in the pixels.
